summary: Focused retest of iteration_16 fix: getAllProducts() merges seller-created products (localStorage sec_seller_products_v1) with static catalog on /boutique and /produit/:id. Full flow verified end-to-end. Custom product with data:image photo appears on public shop, detail page, and cart drawer. All regression paths OK.

issues: Trash/edit icon-only buttons have no data-testid or aria-label, making automated delete testing harder. Consider adding data-testid="delete-product-<id>" and aria-label="Supprimer" for accessibility & test stability.

action_items: Optional: add data-testid/aria-label on the trash icon buttons in /vendeur/produits Actions column for reliable e2e delete testing.
Optional: expose a data-testid on the boutique product card so tests can target it directly (currently identified via anchor href /produit/<id>).
critical_code_review_comments: getAllProducts() helper is correct: filters custom entries by id not in seed set, requires id+name, safe try/catch, no _id leaks.
Products.jsx (line 29) and ProductDetail.jsx (lines 17, 32) both consume getAllProducts() — consistent single source of truth for public shop.
SellerContext PRODUCTS_KEY and data/products.js SELLER_PRODUCTS_KEY both use 'sec_seller_products_v1' — matches (no drift).

Because localStorage is client-only and per-origin, this merge is device-local only. Not persisted across devices — acceptable for demo but should be noted; a real backend would be required for cross-device visibility.
seed_data_creation: None persisted server-side. Test used ephemeral localStorage entries per session; each Playwright session starts with clean storage.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Fix verified: after seller creates a product at /vendeur/ajouter, it appears on /boutique (count went from 10 -> 11), detail page /produit/<newId> renders name + '2 500 F' + data:image photo, and Ajouter au panier drops it into the cart drawer. p1 seed detail still renders 'Casque sans fil Aura Pro'. Full-page seller /vendeur/produits shows '11 produits affichés · 11 au total'. Delete flow not executed programmatically because the trash icon lacks a testid/aria-label — but LS/UI both list the new product, so the fix scope is validated.
